note: sigilix-monitor#29 Greptile-style benchmark fixtures (20 planted bugs / 5 PRs). Used by the in-repo inline-recall replication test (SIG-451). DO NOT EDIT BY HAND — regenerated from the benchmark PR.

bugs.title: Missing R2 object null-check after .get()
bugs.description: Removed the `if (!obj)` guard after env.SIGILIX_TELEMETRY.get(key) and used obj!.arrayBuffer(); a missing/deleted object now throws and drops the whole batch.

bugs.title: dedupeKey tuple omits attempt-identity fields
bugs.description: attemptIndex/attemptKind dropped from the dedupeKey tuple (SIG-277 class): distinct model-attempt-completed events for the same role now hash identically and the second is silently dropped by INSERT OR IGNORE. Subtle: only multi-attempt/rerun events collide.

bugs.title: gzip magic-byte check uses >= instead of ===
bugs.description: Second magic byte compared with `bytes[1]! >= 0x8b` instead of `=== 0x8b` mis-detects compression for some inputs.

bugs.title: Inverted envelope fallback-timestamp precedence
bugs.description: `const ts = fallbackTs ?? asNumber(entry.TimestampMs)` prefers the invocation-level fallback over the per-entry timestamp, bucketing events into the wrong time window. Subtle: only wrong when both are present.

bugs.title: end_to_end GROUP BY check_run_id without owner/repo
bugs.description: Grouping the end-to-end sample by check_run_id alone (owner/repo removed from GROUP BY) risks cross-repo sample contamination.

bugs.title: Non-deterministic recent-runs ordering under LIMIT
bugs.description: Dropped the `, r.head_sha7 DESC` tiebreaker, so ORDER BY COALESCE(started, ended) DESC alone makes the LIMITed page non-deterministic.

bugs.title: Percentile index off-by-one
bugs.description: Percentile index computed as Math.floor(p * sorted.length) instead of p * (sorted.length - 1), returning the wrong sample (p95 ~ max). Subtle: off by one bucket.

bugs.title: Drilldown union not scoped to boundary events
bugs.description: Removed the `event_name IN (boundary events)` gate, so the head_sha7/check_run_id union arm leaks a sibling PR's specialist/fanout events into the timeline.

bugs.title: Session expiry no longer enforced
bugs.description: The `nowMs > payload.exp` clause was dropped from verifySession, so expired session tokens are accepted indefinitely (nowMs becomes unused). Subtle: valid logins still work; expiry silently never enforced.

bugs.title: Protected routes missing no-store
bugs.description: Dropped `c.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store')` in the session gate, letting private dashboard HTML be cached/bfcached.

bugs.title: OAuth state not validated on callback
bugs.description: The state-cookie comparison was removed from /auth/callback, removing CSRF protection on the login flow.

bugs.title: Open redirect via unsanitized post-login target
bugs.description: A `?next=` value is stored in a cookie at /auth/login and redirected to at callback without same-origin validation — an open redirect (also accepts absolute/`//` URLs).

bugs.title: Prune cutoff off-by-one (deletes a day early)
bugs.description: cutoff computed with `(opts.retentionDays - 1) * DAY_MS`, pruning events one day inside the retention window (extra day of data deleted).

bugs.title: batchSize clamp removed → unbounded loop
bugs.description: Removed the Math.max(1, ...) clamp on batchSize; a 0 batch yields LIMIT 0 (deletes nothing) and the loop's `changes < batchSize` exit never trips — infinite loop. Subtle: only on a 0/negative config value.

bugs.title: ALWAYS_DROP no longer drops reviewerEmail
bugs.description: `reviewerEmail` removed from the ALWAYS_DROP set, so reviewer email PII now survives scrubbing into D1. Subtle: nothing fails; one field of a pair silently persists.

bugs.title: Producer-supplied pathHash trusted over computed
bugs.description: `pathHash` removed from ALWAYS_DROP, so a producer-supplied pathHash survives and can overwrite the locally computed hash — path-hash spoofing.

bugs.title: Operational-event reason rendered as raw HTML (XSS)
bugs.description: OpsEventsPanel renders e.props.reason via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so producer-controlled content becomes stored XSS. (Sigilix flagged this class on PR #21.)

bugs.title: statusBadge threshold boundary flip
bugs.description: `ratio <= 0.75` changed to `ratio < 0.75`, so a phase exactly at 75% of target is mislabeled 'approaching' instead of 'within budget'.

bugs.title: fmtMs boundary at exactly 1000ms
bugs.description: `ms < 1000` changed to `ms <= 1000`, so exactly 1000ms renders as '1000 ms' instead of '1.0 s'.

bugs.title: Divide-by-zero in fanout fallback-rate → NaN%
bugs.description: New 'Fallback rate' pill computes fallbacksUsed / totalAttemptsUsed * 100 with no zero guard; a run with totalAttemptsUsed=0 renders NaN%. Subtle: only on runs with no attempts.
